messages.content: 你能給我盧浮宮博物館未來3個月的展覽資訊嗎？然後告訴我巴黎地區最好的意式和中式餐廳嗎？

function.name: restaurant_info
function.description: Get restaurant information for a specific area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: Location for which to find restaurants.

food_type.description: Type of cuisine for which to find restaurants. Default is 'all' if not specified.

function.name: exhibition_info
function.description: Get exhibition information for a specific museum. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

museum_name.description: Name of the museum for which to find exhibitions.

month.description: Number of upcoming months for which to retrieve exhibition details. Default is 1 if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants exhibition info for Louvre Museum for next 3 months and best Italian and Chinese restaurants in Paris region. We need to call two functions: exhibition_info with museum_name="Louvre Museum", month=3; and restaurant_info twice: one for location="Paris region" food_type="Italian", another for location="Paris region" food_type="Chinese". The user didn't specify location exactly but says "巴黎地區" which is "Paris region". So we can use location="Paris region". For food_type, we can pass "Italian" and "Chinese". Then we need to combine results. We'll call the functions accordingly.

We should call the first function: exhibition_info({"museum_name":"Louvre Museum","month":3}). Then second: restaurant_info({"location":"Paris region","food_type":"Italian"}). Third: restaurant_info({"location":"Paris region","food_type":"Chinese"}).

We need to output the combined results. We'll do separate calls. Let's do it.
